name: Whites Creek, Annandale: a tidal channel into Rozelle Bay, kept at the sea's level

water.why: A concrete channel under the trees from Annandale to Rozelle Bay, open to the tide (NSW's aerial), that OSM draws as untagged water ending 190 m short of the bay where it passes under The Crescent and the light rail: the sea's rule (tools/sea-water.mjs) would take it for a pond
